an7.67:1.1: Yato kho bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhittaṃ hoti catunnañ ca āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī:
an7.67:1.2: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
an7.67:2.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhi.
an7.67:2.3: Iminā paṭhamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhittaṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 3.
an7.67:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare parikhā hoti gambhīrā c' eva vitthatā ca.
an7.67:3.2: Iminā dutiyena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhittaṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 4.
an7.67:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco c' eva vitthato ca.
an7.67:4.2: Iminā tatiyena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhittaṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 5.
an7.67:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sanniciṭaṃ hoti salākañ c' eva jevanīyañ ca.
an7.67:5.2: Iminā catutthena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhittaṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 6.
an7.67:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahu balakāyo paṭivasati, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:6.2: hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyikā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.
an7.67:6.3: Iminā pañcamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhittaṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 7.
an7.67:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
an7.67:7.2: Iminā chaṭṭhena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhittaṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 8.
an7.67:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco c' eva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca.
an7.67:8.2: Iminā sattamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhittaṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:9.1: Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī? 9.
an7.67:9.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 10.
an7.67:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 11.
an7.67:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamāsāparaṇṇaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. 12.
an7.67:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:12.2: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ, abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:12.3: Imesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an7.67:13.1: Yato kho bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ imehi sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhittaṃ hoti imesañ ca catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī:
an7.67:13.2: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
an7.67:13.3: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yato ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti catunnañ ca jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī:
an7.67:13.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo Mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimato.
an7.67:14.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhi abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:14.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddhati Tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an7.67:14.3: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an7.67:14.4: Saddhāsiko bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
an7.67:15.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare parikhā hoti gambhīrā c' eva vitthatā ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:15.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako hirimā hoti, hiriyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.67:15.3: Hiriparikho bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
an7.67:16.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco c' eva vitthato ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:16.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako ottappī hoti, ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.67:16.3: Ottappapariyāyapatho bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
an7.67:17.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākañ c' eva jevanīyañ ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:17.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an7.67:17.3: Sutāvudho bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
an7.67:18.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahu balakāyo paṭivasati, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:18.2: hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyikā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:18.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an7.67:18.4: Viriyabalakāyo bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
an7.67:19.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:19.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatam pi cirabhāsitam pi saritā anussaritā.
an7.67:19.3: Satidovāriko bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
an7.67:20.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco c' eva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:20.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti, udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an7.67:20.3: Paññāvāsanalepanasampanno bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti;
an7.67:21.1: Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī? 20.
an7.67:21.2: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:21.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:21.4: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 21.
an7.67:22.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:22.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:22.3: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 22.
an7.67:23.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamāsāparaṇṇaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:23.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:23.3: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 23.
an7.67:24.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:24.2: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ, abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:24.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:24.4: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an7.67:24.5: Imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an7.67:25.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako imehi sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti imesañ ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī:
an7.67:25.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo Mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimato
